The [[City/Legends|urban center]] of '''Crystal City''' was [[Domed city/Legends|enclosed in a dome]] and located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] during the height of the [[Je'daii Order]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. It was situated eight hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] to the south of [[Greenwood Station]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

Circa [[25,797 BBY]], a family associated with the [[Shikaakwa]]n [[Volke House]] used information provided by the crime lord [[Maxhagan]] to create a production base in the city. When the family refused to pay Maxhagan for his investment, he helped to fund a [[feud in Crystal City]] that ended after three thousand individuals were killed. With all of the Volke associates on Nox dead, Maxhagan viewed the debt as paid.<ref name="Into the Void" />
